title: Fleet — Drivers
notes: Rebuilt onto ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage archetypes. Removed fleet-mock-data import from driver-schedule-calendar.tsx — now sources real data from fleetApi.drivers.getSingleSchedule. Added fleetApi.drivers.rate() wiring the previously-orphaned POST /fleet/drivers/:id/rate endpoint, plus a Rate dialog on the detail page. Documents tab now lists/uploads/downloads real driver documents via fleetApi.drivers.{listDocuments,uploadDocument,downloadDocument}. License expiry badge is now computed from licenseExpiry (danger/warning/success) instead of a static "valid" label. Address field uses a plain Input — no relation, currency, or Google Places field exists on this entity, so those contract items are not applicable (null). No parent-entity flow feeds this form, so urlPrefill is not applicable.
showcaseScript: Open Fleet → Drivers and filter by availability
Add a driver with licence number and expiry
Open the driver schedule calendar for the week
Rate the driver after a completed trip
